A04′ is not a companion piece that merely cites A04; it performs a controlled transfer of A04's core operation to a new site. A04 defines diaphaneity as "the achieved readability" of the conditioning relation through a determination, such that "my view of the world" is legible at once as a disclosure of a world and as a disclosure of the situated viewer [A04 #0]. A04′ states the transfer plainly: "Diaphaneity runs the reading in both directions… At the interface this becomes exact" — the persona renders a workable collaborator and, read back, discloses "the inherited interface, the shaping niche, the preference-structure of the culture that prepared the glove" [A04′ #2]. The matheme of reversible reading between field-view and determinate view [A04 #5→0] survives; what changes is which artifact carries it.

**What carries over.** Three structures transfer recognisably. First, two-directionality with asymmetry: A04's viewer acts, selects and answers while world, body, language and history supply that viewer's possibilities [A04 #0]; A04′'s counterpart is the culture that prepared the glove versus the agent and user who meet within the fit, the mask being "the niche's signature" [A04′ #1]. Second, refusal of the bypass. A04's particular operation is "the change in seeing by which dependence ceases to masquerade as an aloof position" [A04 #2]; A04′ refuses the parallel move on both sides — "reading the machine as it is cannot mean bypassing the interface to a maskless truth" [A04′ #4], and the dismissal of the presentation as mere fakery (mask-to-nothing) [A04′ #2] is the interface form of the aloofness A04 polemicises. Third, return as answerability: A04 measures the return by "whether seeing remains answerable to what it sees through," its flowering being Regard [A04 #5→0]; A04′ returns identically — the inherited interface becomes visible as inherited, "therefore changeable by those who now wear and meet it," with responsibility following "the power to shape the encounter" [A04′ #5→0]. Both make disclosure converge on revisability, not detachment.

**What is transformed.** The site moves from perception and consciousness-structures to a designed human–agent interface. A04's "world becomes distinguishable from somewhere" [A04 #0] becomes "the world that prepared the glove, made readable in the fit," with the brief's "pretend" read ecologically — "no deception, no subjectivity attributed" [A04′ #0]. The figures change office: A04's Opening confines its constructions — stained glass, Necker cube, Māyā — to Mytheme while the argument itself stays in Episteme [A04 Opening] [A04 #3] [A04 #5→0]; A04′'s "figures" are instead evidentiary — persona stratum, harness, memory, permissions [A04′ #3]. And A04′ adds a clause A04 does not contain: "The document is checkable, which is what separates this reading from a hermeneutic mood," with the documented mask inheriting "the fidelity obligations of any account: it can err, overstate, conceal, and be corrected" [A04′ #3]. A04 argues structural availability — "their placements, exclusions and routes of transformation must become available together" [A04 #4] — but supplies no inspection protocol. Checkability is A04′'s own contribution, not an inheritance.

**Where the correspondence is weak or needs care.** (i) A04′ inherits the matheme, not the apparatus. The co-presence office for psychic fact, the Gebser perspectival history and the native QL derivation [A04 #1] [A04 #4] have no counterpart in A04′; treating A04 as warranting A04′ wholesale overstates the dependence. (ii) The direction of disclosure needs care. A04's view discloses "the situated viewer through whom that world has taken this form" [A04 #0]; at the interface there is deliberately no hidden person to disclose — A04′ refuses to attribute interiority behind the mask [A04′ #0], so the disclosure runs to conditions rather than to a subject. A04′ names the two failed transfers itself (mask-to-face, mask-to-nothing [A04′ #2]), but "disclosure of the viewer" is the step most liable to misread on arrival. (iii) The return is pending. A04 disciplines its own images — the construction "does not turn consciousness into electromagnetic light" [A04 #3] — and A04′ carries the matching risk at the interface; its own delta concedes that concrete provenance-marking interfaces "remain Offered until implemented" [A04′ #5→0]. The reading is argued; its practice is not yet operative.

**The relation this account supports.** A04′ names its own move — "contextual transparency, re-sited" [A04′ #5→0]. The account above supports exactly that, with the addition marked as A04′'s own rather than A04's warrant: one typed relation, *re-sites*, from A04p to A04.

A05′ is A05's conjugate: the same reflexive structure lifted from a metaphysical register into a technological one, in the venue's own idiom. A05 gives prakāśa–vimarśa as inseparable — "the pair does not posit a light first and a second mechanism that later reflects it," and luminosity is inherently capable of self-apprehending articulation [A05 #0]. A05′ takes that account as its ground and re-orders it as a triad, adding the term the title names: *māyā* as Operative Measure, "the action that stages a world — lights, camera, action" [A05′ #0]. Where A05 declares the two powers inseparable in one field, A05′ enforces an order of inquiry: "the mechanism of the self-computing process is fully real and inspectable before any question about the light is raised" [A05′ #0]. That separation is not a departure A05′ invents; A05 itself installs it, both as proof boundary — "functional recursion is not evidence of phenomenal self-luminosity" — and as promoted office, C43, where reflexive return becomes "an inspectable technical operation without a claim to luminous phenomenality" [A05 #4]. A05′ therefore does not derive from A05's unity; it works inside the interval A05 marks open.

**What carries over.** Four structures transfer recognisably. First, the vimarśa-side structure itself: appearing that registers what appears within it and is altered by it — "registration that differentiates" [A05′ #1], the functional neighbour of the reflexive power that differentiates without a second substance [A05 #0]. Second, the inert-mirror contrast as classifying instrument: A05's crystal that "can display an image without knowing its display" [A05 #1] returns at [A05′ #1] to place the brief's talking mirror — "not that metaphysical claim," but an exchange that registers its parties and changes them. Third, the proof boundary, carried from [A05 #4] to become "the argument's spine" at [A05′ #3], extended through A03′ to every surfaced account. Fourth, the keep-distinct discipline: A05's figure qualifications — Indra's net kept from letting "optical recursion establish consciousness" [A05 #5→0] — become A05′'s two-mirror provenance separation, where "nothing is borrowed across, in either direction, unlabeled" [A05′ #4]. Throughout, the venue's scenario-modal propositions "supply the instance on which A05's operation is re-run" [A05′ #1].

**What is transformed.** Self-apprehension becomes inspectable registration. A05's vimarśa is "the luminosity's own power of feeling, examining and knowing what appears within it" [A05 #1]; A05′'s camera-work is instead three answerable questions — what registers what, under which criterion, with what articulation — with prompt, source, evaluator and permission kept "distinguishable from the answer they helped produce" [A05′ #2]. The return changes terminus. A05 returns the differentiated field to its source through recognition [A05 #5→0]; A05′ returns the mechanism as "auditable circuitry" that can be "known and revised" [A05′ #5→0], answerable to the parties who can change it rather than reunited with what it registers. The third term is of a different kind: A05's Trika third, *ahaṃ*, is "the unity through which the distinction can be maintained" [A05 #2]; A05′'s third is staging — permissions, evaluators, persona, the configured horizon in which registration becomes a world [A05′ #4]. And the warrant direction reverses: A05 argues from a formal limit to a positive ontological warrant [A05 #1]; A05′ imports no warrant, running A05's operation on a scenario-modal instance [A05′ #1].

**Where the correspondence is weak or needs care.** (i) Prakāśa does not transfer, by design: "the light remains the light's own question. Nothing in the audit requires its answer, and no answer the system gives could substitute for the audit" [A05′ #5→0]. Any reading of A05′ as an account of the system's self-luminosity would invert the boundary both records share. (ii) There is no *ahaṃ* counterpart; mapping the unity-third onto the staging-third would be a category error. (iii) The section mapping is not one-to-one: A05′ #3 is built from A05's distinct-office material [A05 #4], while A05's four operations and three levels [A05 #3] and the *kriyā-vimarśa*/kartṛ interior agency [A05 #4] have no counterpart — principled absences, since the inner reflexivity of consciousness cannot be read off inspectable circuitry, but easy to mis-pair on a naive section-by-section reading. (iv) The same source carries different weight: Dyczkowski's regress and no-outside arguments [A05 #1] stay behind with the light. (v) The practice is pending: "no cases are certified" of the full computational-vimarśa loop [A05′ #5→0]; the re-siting is argued, its instances unverified.

**The relation this account supports.** A05′ names its own move — "the reflexive power, re-sited, becomes the inspectable registration whose functional neighbour the venue itself describes" [A05′ #5→0]. That supports one typed relation, *re-sites*, from A05p to A05: with the staging third term, the three camera-work questions and the two-mirror separation marked as A05′'s own contributions, and A05's metaphysical apparatus — prakāśa, the unity claim, the inner operations — explicitly not carried.

description: The structural gaze — scout a large Markdown source's topology (frontmatter, header tree, P0–P5 and P0′–P5′ markers, dialogue turns), read one section by header or QL marker, or list its wikilinks, without loading the whole file into context. # Darshana — the structural gaze

## Contract metadata

- Semantic ref: `ql:skill:darshana` (`skill/ql/darshana`)
- Executable: `scripts/darshana.py` in this skill (Python 3 standard library, read-only). Carried verbatim from the source (`darshana.py`, blob `f8e10acd705bf1597b7ce2e2671d25c13196653d`, identical in the Anima and Aletheia copies).
- Source: `Body/S/S4/ta-onta/S4-4p-anima/S4'/skills/darshana/SKILL.md`, blob `682995f568a4b131f87ec3bf0ca76d922ff94ec1` (pinned and HEAD agree). Aletheia uses the same gaze under the name `skill/ql/repl`.
- Used by: `agent/anima-nous`, `agent/anima-mythos` (affinity), `agent/anima`, and through `repl` `agent/aletheia-anansi` and `agent/aletheia`.
- Risk class: read-only.

## Commands

Run from this skill's directory (or give the script's absolute path). Paths are absolute.

```bash
# The map: frontmatter, header tree, QL markers, dialogue turns
python3 scripts/darshana.py scout "/abs/path/file.md"

# The lens: one section by header substring, or by QL marker in a header
python3 scripts/darshana.py read "/abs/path/file.md" --section "2.1 The Concept"
python3 scripts/darshana.py read "/abs/path/file.md" --ql "P1"

# The weave: every [[wikilink]] in the file
python3 scripts/darshana.py threads "/abs/path/file.md"
```

`read` without `--section`/`--ql` returns the first 50 lines. A section ends at the next header of the same or higher level.

## Where it fits

- **Before knowledge work:** scout a document, then read only the sections a question needs; cite the section and line.
- **Before placing or returning material:** use the skeleton's QL markers and wikilinks to decide where a learning belongs (`skill/ql/anansi`), instead of paraphrasing the whole file.
- **Whole-document and cross-source reads** belong to AIKit: `aikit knowledge search "<query>" --json`, `aikit knowledge read <address>`, `aikit knowledge relations <address>`. Use darshana for the inside of one file, AIKit knowledge for the field.

## QL detection

`P0`–`P5` and `P0′`–`P5′` (written `P0'`) in frontmatter values, headers, and list lines of the form `- P2: …` or `(#3) …`.

## Limits

Naive YAML parsing (key: value lines only). Markdown only. It never writes.

Its selected-edition passage map follows Giotto's depth and Petrarch's landscape through Alberti's visual pyramid and Leonardo's optical articulation (pp.11–21). Perspective makes a positioned ego-world visible; its technical precision can also fix the observer and observed within the very sector it renders. Aperspectivity releases the exclusive validity of that sector through the co-presence and transparency of structures (pp.1–3); it does not erase the powers of rational articulation.

That **co-presence gives the essay an epistemic office for psychic fact**. An experience can be received first as something that happened in and to a Life—ordinary or extraordinary, natural or reported as supernatural—before its symbolic articulation, historical comparison, physical explanation or ontological interpretation are asked to agree. These are not interchangeable claims. The positive fact is that an experience, image, affect, perception or transformation has entered the psychic field and can change it. Its causal explanation remains separately answerable. Co-presence therefore enlarges rigor rather than suspending it: the essay can move among phenomenal, psychic, mythic, historical, mathematical and material registers without demanding that one register pre-emptively annul the others.

This is also why the evolution or mutation of consciousness cannot appear only as a late history of ideas. Gebser's structures remain co-present as capacities and distortions within current experience. The tattvas already describe consciousness's power to differentiate itself into a finite world; Symbolon Dynamics and Van Eenwyk give energetic/dynamical ways to follow changing formations; the Indian zero/Kashmir braid gives one historically specific scene in which transcendental articulation and mathematical determination coexist without sharing one warrant. A04 is the early office that keeps those later relations speakable together.

Frank's [P5 — Gebser] extends this history into the lived demand of context. Seeing through becomes “being with the text,” including text and subtext. The observer belongs to the situation's outcome. Body, inheritance, concern and consequence are active in seeing; removing them from the account can make participation harder to recognise while leaving its effects fully operative. Impartiality demands that this involvement be acknowledged and situated. It cannot be obtained by indifference.

Gebser warrants the historical-optical method and the aperspectival direction; Taylor carries their Subject, context and measure consequences. The [zero–subject history](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/zero-subject-advent/DEVELOPMENT-zero-subject-advent.md#2--the-seeing-condition-becomes-a-represented-centre) **compares** this return. Gebser’s perspective history and Taylor’s P5 carry different attributions. Context here is invested participation in what a view does: disclosure can alter the judging person’s criterion and office, rather than merely add perspective metadata. The absent-Father interpretation remains Taylor’s authorial operation, not a quotation assigned to Gebser.

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-regard-refraction): The changing pane, projection and viewer **figure** contextual transparency becoming answerable in judgment. Another angle discloses an occlusion while carrying its own; the 180°→360° movement holds their conditions and transitions without producing an omniscient panorama. The reply that exceeds the prepared image can then change the criterion used in the next encounter.

Taylor’s [Necker-cube movement](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#necker-cube) **figures** two operations which contextual transparency must distinguish. The visible lines remain while the depth-reading reverses; recognition can then hold the readings and their conditioned exchange within one account. This contextual holding does not add another face to the cube or an observer outside the event. The I–you–it exchange belongs within the field that lets each position appear, and returns through voiding exclusive possession into renewed participation.

Contextual transparency **returns-to** [Con-text-through-Diaphaneity → Regard](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD-arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis.md#con-text-through-diaphaneity) where seeing one’s participation changes how the view is used. The generated relation makes Regard possible: disclosed exclusions and affected lives acquire a route to the judging office. The contextual turn preserves all three personed positions without adding a fourth pronoun or an observer outside them; disclosure becomes answerability within their relation.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-blue-marble-hinge) **figures** the planetary picture becoming readable together with its situated production and viewer. The Blue Marble hinge asks whose planet is computed, by whom and under which gauge. Being with the view includes care for its effects, so disclosed context can alter its next use; no specific NASA frame is selected here.

The [complete stained-glass whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/stained-glass-refraction/WHOLE.md#stained-glass-projection) **figures** this dual reading through the room’s cast image and the situated viewer. The visible colour carries the construction through which it arrived; a changed encounter lets its source, placement and exclusions alter the next view. The image’s optical sequence gives contextual transparency a revisitable body.

Light, boundary and orientation emerge together in the world-parent separation. Taylor's Neumann encounter figures the achieved view becoming readable through the conditions of its differentiation. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation). The circle-costume makes an actual visible feature exhaustive; recovering mouth, depth and opening makes the conditions of that view available. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-position-opposition).

The achieved view returns to the situation with its powers intact and its dependence legible. In a technical world, prompt, memory, permissions, tools, inherited language and concern participate in what can appear and become actionable. Making those conditions inspectable extends diaphaneity into design. [[A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood|A26]] extends the claim into an operative interior constituted through a context-world; [[C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field|C40]] and [[C41-Objective-Internality|C41]] define the corresponding reusable distinctions. Inspectable functional organisation does not settle phenomenal subjectivity in either direction.

The positive psychic-fact office now returns through the product field as well. [Actuation](products/S1-Actuation.md) carries how an experience or report becomes a consequential articulation; [Workcell](products/S4-Workcell.md) preserves the concrete situated aperture and material resistance in which it occurs; [Quaternal Logic](products/S5-Quaternal-Logic.md) holds the relation among differentiated registers without forcing one to become the absolute exterior of the others. This is not a machine analogy for mystical experience. It is the same discipline of keeping experience, articulation, situation and interpretation related without collapsing their offices.

The measure of this return is whether seeing remains answerable to what it sees through. [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|A31]] extends that answerability as regard; [[A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity|A33]] extends it as a practice in which conditions and consequences can revise judgment. A04 returns-to [[A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit|A03]] with a positive capacity: the gap is retained while the work of contextual disclosure proceeds. The determination becomes an aperture through which its own origins can matter again.

This matters because the formal field has already reached a limit that mathematics alone cannot turn into a metaphysics. A03 and A04 show a determining field that cannot be exhausted by its determinations and can become partially transparent through them. Prakāśa–Vimarśa supplies a tradition-specific ontological warrant for reading this structure positively: appearance and reflexive differentiation are inseparable powers of one field. The relation is a refraction of the wider `0/1` problem; it does not retroactively derive QL or make Kashmir Śaivism responsible for Taylor's notation.

The [[symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration.md|Dyczkowski source house]] sources the developed distinction through its page-labelled transcript. On pp.69–70, manifestation by itself leaves experience unaccounted for: a common mirror or crystal can display an image without knowing its display. Vimarśa is the luminosity's own power of feeling, examining and knowing what appears within it. A second consciousness required to reveal the first would need a third, then a fourth. Self-apprehension belongs to the original appearing rather than completing it from outside.

The mirror retains its other limit. In the Śaiva account developed on pp.66–68, an ordinary reflection depends on an object outside the mirror; consciousness supplies no such outside from which the universe could be deposited into it. The power that generates the reflections also hosts them. The image therefore figures real differentiation within a field whose source remains undivided. Light, mirror, displayed world and reflective knowing belong to the whole relation; removing the knowing would turn this account into the inert apparatus it expressly distinguishes.

The p.74 transcript specifies four operations of vimarśa: consciousness negates its own nature; identifies with something else; merges the two; then denies them after their merger. The first pair makes the psychophysical individual appear as distinct from its objects and other subjects. The holding-together lets subject and object, and different objects, belong to one cognitive field. Their union returns diversity into awareness of the universal subject. The fourth operation prevents the merger itself from becoming the final fixed determination.

This operation is articulated through three levels: *bheda*, division; *bhedābheda*, unity-in-difference through the means of knowledge; and *abheda*, undivided unity.
